labels.notes: There is no paper label. The check is that the four redefined notions mean what they meant at HEAD and that no statement changed. Causality.dual (Causal/Causality.lean:104, :234) defines dual.le U x y := le U y x and dual.lt U x y := lt U y x. dual_Jplus is C.dual.Jplus = C.Jminus, by rfl (:122), and dual_dual is rfl (:243). So C.dual.ChronalFutureNeighbours unfolds to the HEAD body ∀ V, ∀ v ∈ V, ∃ p ∈ V, C.lt V p v, and C.dual.NoFutureEndpoint to ∀ x, C.Jminus ⊤ {x} ≠ {x}. My probe (/tmp, `import Causal`) copied the four HEAD bodies verbatim (git show HEAD:lean-causal/Causal/LadderLocal.lean:159, :164, :168, :173) as oldCPN, oldCN, oldNPE and oldNCE. It proved these by `rfl`, as equalities of Props, which is stronger than Iff.rfl: C.ChronalPastNeighbours = oldCPN C; C.dual.ChronalPastNeighbours = oldCPN C.dual; C.ChronalFutureNeighbours = oldCPN C.dual (the HEAD future side); C.ChronalNeighbours = oldCN C; C.NoPastEndpoint = oldNPE C; C.NoFutureEndpoint = oldNPE C.dual; C.NoCausalEndpoint = oldNCE C. The projections h.1 : oldCPN C, h.2 : oldCPN C.dual, and likewise for NoCausalEndpoint, elaborate, so .1 is still the past side and .2 the future side. ChronalFutureNeighbours (:166) is literally Lemma K's hZp (Causal/LemmaK.lean:100). #print shows chronalPastNeighbours_def, noPastEndpoint_def, dual_chronalFutureNeighbours and dual_noFutureEndpoint as `fun … => Iff.rfl`. The four definitions are still semireducible, with levels and telescope unchanged. The new future lemmas are the mirrors they claim to be. noFutureEndpoint_iff has ∃ y, y ≠ x ∧ C.le ⊤ x y, and noPastEndpoint_iff := noFutureEndpoint_iff (C := C.dual) keeps HEAD's text, ∃ y, y ≠ x ∧ C.le ⊤ y x. mem_Zplus, Iplus_nonempty(_of_mem), the AbsolutelyMinimal and CausallyArcConnected chronalFutureNeighbours_iff, and the IsCausalIso invariances are each the past lemma at C.dual. No `**` mark was added, and every module's mark set equals HEAD's.

All 57 blocks are byte-identical to their checks-before.txt blocks.
